prompt: Night over the rooftops of an English town, seen from a quiet residential street: in the middle distance a police helicopter tilts sideways, its white searchlight beam swinging wildly across the clouds as it slowly drops below the roofline. No fire, no smoke. 35mm documentary photograph, grain, cold blue night, the searchlight the one bright stroke, no readable writing anywhere.
